subject: [PATCH 04/22] mm/page_alloc: build zonelists from common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the way zonelists are built in the Linux kernel's memory management system. Instead of building fallback lists for all nodes and local lists only for non-common nodes, it builds common memory zonelists from N_MEMORY_COMMON and local-only zonelists for common nodes. This change is achieved by refactoring the build_local_zonelist function to reuse code for building a local-only zonelist for nodes outside the common set. The patch does not affect nodes with no memory, as they do not have zones to list anyway.
